notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for an adapter-supplied rich FOM transportation type used by a timestamped regional interaction. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, logical-time implementation, DDM dimensions, endpoint, callback model, and object/attribute/interaction/parameter/transportation names. It verifies timestamped interaction publication, regional subscription overlap, conveyed region metadata, payload, tag, producer, logical time, order, retraction, and transportation identity without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction, DDM, transportation, and time-management services with FederateAmbassador interaction, retraction, and time-advance callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction and time-management declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
